description: Slot 2: three bordered hero cards, each a 2-col copy/image split. The slot EXISTS on all six routes but carries `hideSection: true` on five of them, and a hidden section emits zero DOM — so it renders on /shipping only.

subheading.note: item 3 stores a single space " " in the CMS, producing an EMPTY h6 of height 0 that still contributes its 24px mb-6 — so that card’s copy sits 24px lower than items 1-2. Deliberate; keep it.

provenance.note: Provenance of this asset in the page being specified. `generated` is FORBIDDEN for any assetRole whose generationPolicy is must-not-fabricate-real-brand or must-not-fabricate-compliance-claim, and for must-reuse-exact roles. Enforced by compatibility/graph.json#ASSET_PROVENANCE_POLICY and schema/semantic_validate.py.

aspectRatio.note: CSS aspect-ratio for the wrapper box (e.g. "799/617"). Used by Rive assets, which have no intrinsic pixel size, INSTEAD of intrinsicWidth/Height.

content.note: item 2’s CMS value carries a real TRAILING NEWLINE

summary.note: The stats strip, which overlaps the hero card by 1px via -mt-px.

items.note: item 2’s third bullet carries a real TRAILING SPACE

list.note: 4 bullets, rendered in a 2-col grid at EVERY viewport, each in its own square-bracket cell with a {color.sun} 6px dot.

responsive.base: card copy/image stacked, copy px-6 py-7 pb-0

notes: `mt-3!` is an important override in the original: the paragraph margin-top is 12px at EVERY viewport and the sm:mt-4 / lg:mt-6 that follow it are dead. Ported as `!mt-3`.
The bullet dot carries both md:top-[0.4375rem] and md:top-[0.5625rem] in the original; the latter wins -> top: 9px.
copyBudgetDerivation: Each maxWords budget is max(measured+2, ceil(measured*1.25)). The measured maxima were computed by importing the real src/data/*.js modules and word-counting every string for that field across every route. See extraction/measured-values.json#copyBudgets.
